questions.stem: This question is about metal carbonates. When heated, some metal carbonates decompose to form a metal oxide and carbon dioxide gas.

parts.text: A student is given a solid metal carbonate with the formula $ \mathrm{X C O}_{3} $ X represents the symbol of a Group 2 metal. A student uses this apparatus to heat a sample of $ \mathrm{X C O_{3}} $ until it all decomposes. The equation for the decomposition of $ \mathrm{X C O_{3}} $ is $\mathrm {X C O} _ {3} \rightarrow \mathrm {X O} + \mathrm {C O} _ {2}$ The student records the mass of $ \mathrm{X C O_{3}} $ and the mass of carbon dioxide that escapes through the cotton wool plug. parts.label: b-i

parts.label: b-ii
